entities.name: José María Lacunza
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José María Lacunza Blengio was a Mexican politician and diplomat. In 1836, with his brother Juan Nepomuceno Lacunza, he founded the Academia de Letrán, where he published his Historical Discourses. As a columnist he wrote for El Mosaico Mexicano, El Siglo Diez y Nueve and El Monitor Republicano.
